parameters.query: SELECT t.code, t.name, t.short_name, t.sport, t.logo_key, t.area, t.city, m.role, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_members x WHERE x.team_id = t.id AND x.status = 'ACTIVE' AND x.role <> 'COACH') AS members FROM team_members m JOIN app_users u ON u.id = m.user_id JOIN teams t ON t.id = m.team_id WHERE u.phone = $1 AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY FIELD(m.role, 'COACH', 'CAPTAIN', 'VICE_CAPTAIN', 'PLAYER'), t.name
